Parameters.Name: GraphType
Parameters.Description: The kind of graph to generate: PETERSEN, CYCLE, COMPLETE, STAR, PATH (Type0); QUEEN, MYCIEL (Type2).

Parameters.Name: GraphParam
Parameters.Description: Structural parameter of the graph (number of vertices for CYCLE/COMPLETE/PATH, number of leaves for STAR, board size n for QUEEN, chromatic number k for MYCIEL).

Parameters.Name: N
Parameters.Description: Number of vertices, used by the Erdos-Renyi random graph generator (Type1).

Parameters.Name: P
Parameters.Description: Edge probability (0..1), used by the Erdos-Renyi random graph generator (Type1).

Parameters.Name: Seed
Parameters.Description: Random seed for reproducible random graph generation (Type1).

Parameters.Name: Filename
Parameters.Description: Name of the edge-list resource file for real-world social network graphs (Type3).

Parameters.Name: GraphName
Parameters.Description: Human-readable name of the graph, shown in results (Type3).

Generators.Description: Classic named graphs: Petersen, cycles, complete graphs, star graphs, paths.
Erdos-Renyi random graph G(N, P) with a given seed.
DIMACS-style benchmark graphs: Queen(n,n) and Mycielski Myciel(k).
Real-world social network graphs read from an edge-list resource file: Zachary Karate Club, Zebra, Dolphin, Florentine Families, Davis Southern Women.
